parameters.name: InstanceUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the agent that is used to back up the data of the database.

> You can call the [DescribeUniBackupDatabase](~~DescribeUniBackupDatabase~~) operation to query the UUID.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the database precheck task.

> You can call the [StartPreCheckDatabase](~~StartPreCheckDatabase~~) operation to query the ID of the database precheck task.

parameters.name: UniRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the server that hosts the database.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas query-pre-check-database --task-id t-000bc9nqwxsbyvod0000 --instance-uuid ebc895506c6911ed800000163e0e0000 --uni-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
